title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Tuesday, 20 October 2026
description: Google's open Gemma 4 model contrasts with Microsoft's tightly controlled Azure-only models, Australia's housing auction clearance rates slide sharply ahead of November's RBA decision, a $2 billion deal unlocks infrastructure for 51,000 new Queensland homes, and a $580 million Broadbeach tower wins approval on the Gold Coast. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
